meta.title: All measure contracts: the OIR measures and the US civil airspace types

anvil-aca.description: Formal airspace coordination area along the Anvil battery's line of fire into Onyx; aircraft inside it are reasonably safe from the surface fires.
anvil-aca.name: Anvil ACA

coordination_instructions: Request transit from Banshee; expect to hold at Bolt until the battery checks fire.
anvil-roz.description: Restricted Operating Zone around the Anvil HIMARS firing point while it fires into the Onyx kill box.
anvil-roz.name: Anvil fires ROZ
anvil-roz.notes: Hot 1315Z to 1445Z; expect short-notice extension for troops in contact.
anvil-roz.purpose: Protect aircraft from the surface fires of the Anvil battery.
restrictions: Aircraft other than the Anvil observation flight remain outside while the zone is active.

coordination_instructions: Check in on the Basin control frequency 10 nm before the boundary.
basin-hidacz.description: High-density airspace control zone over the northern objective area, where helicopters, observation drones and fires are concentrated; the Lantern no-fly zone is cut out of it.
basin-hidacz.name: Basin HIDACZ
basin-hidacz.purpose: Coordinate the concentrated objective-area users under one controlling agency.
restrictions: Enter only with a clearance from the Basin airspace control element.

coordination_instructions: Fires across the boundary are coordinated with the adjacent task force.
bastion-basin-boundary.description: Lateral boundary between Task Force Bastion to the east and Task Force Basin to the west, from PL BRASS to PL ZINC.
bastion-basin-boundary.name: Task Force Bastion and Task Force Basin boundary

bastion-bullseye.description: OIR bullseye for bearing and range calls; bearings from it are magnetic.
bastion-bullseye.name: Bastion

coordination_instructions: Coordinate with Warhawk and Darkstar before flying or firing through 11000 feet MSL inside the Task Force Bastion area.
No coordinating altitude applies beyond the FSCL or inside an open kill box.
bastion-ca.description: Coordinating altitude over Task Force Bastion, from the boundary to the RFL and from PL BRASS to the FSCL; Warhawk controls the assigned airspace below it, and Darkstar the airspace above it.
bastion-ca.name: OIR coordinating altitude

bastion-mrr.description: Low-level minimum-risk route from Cedar across the forward line of own troops for helicopter and low-flying traffic.
bastion-mrr.name: Bastion minimum-risk route
bastion-mrr.purpose: Cross the FLOT with the least known hazard from friendly fires.

bolt-ip.description: Initial point for attack runs into the Cobalt and Onyx kill boxes.
bolt-ip.name: Bolt

cedar-strip-class-d.description: US Class D airspace around the Cedar Strip airfield, from the surface to 2500 feet above it.
cedar-strip-class-d.name: Cedar Strip Class D

cobalt-buffer.description: Buffer zone separating the Basin HIDACZ from the Cobalt and Onyx kill boxes to the east.
cobalt-buffer.name: Cobalt buffer zone
cobalt-buffer.purpose: Keep a lateral buffer between objective-area traffic and kill box attacks.

dagger-cp.description: Contact point where strike flight leads check in with Banshee.
dagger-cp.name: Dagger

coordination_instructions: The using agency requests the ATCAA from the air route traffic control centre; it is not charted.
desert-atcaa.description: ATC-assigned airspace over the Desert MOA, from flight level 180 to flight level 260; it extends the MOA activity into Class A airspace.
desert-atcaa.name: Desert ATCAA

desert-moa.description: US military operations area west of Juniper Field. It ends below flight level 180, and the Desert ATCAA lies above it.
desert-moa.name: Desert MOA
restrictions: Nonparticipating IFR traffic is cleared through only when ATC separates it.

coordination_instructions: Coordinate with the air defence controller before entering; use the Silver transit corridor otherwise.
granite-mez.description: Low- to medium-altitude missile engagement zone around the coalition Granite surface-to-air missile battery.
granite-mez.name: Granite missile engagement zone

granite-tl.description: Traverse level for crossing the Granite low-level air defence area.
granite-tl.name: Granite traverse level

juniper-field-class-b.description: US Class B airspace with a surface area and two shelves around Juniper Field; each shelf has its own floor and ceiling.
juniper-field-class-b.name: Juniper Field Class B

juniper-wash-rfa.description: Restrictive fire area over a friendly logistics site south of the FLOT.
juniper-wash-rfa.name: Juniper Wash RFA
restrictions: Fires that exceed these restrictions require coordination with the land force fire support element.

kestrel-isr.description: Identification safety range around the Kestrel surface action group in the eastern Mediterranean, south-east of Cyprus.
kestrel-isr.name: Kestrel identification safety range

kestrel-misarc.description: Missile arc from the Kestrel destroyer toward an inbound target track from the north-east.
kestrel-misarc.name: Kestrel missile arc

lantern-nfz.description: No-fly zone over the Lantern village inside the objective area.
lantern-nfz.name: Lantern no-fly zone
restrictions: No aircraft operations except those authorised by Banshee as the enforcing authority.

mesquite-tfr.description: Temporary flight restriction under 14 CFR 91.137 around a wildfire east of Juniper Field.
mesquite-tfr.name: Mesquite fire TFR
restrictions: Only aircraft that support the fire suppression enter the TFR.

oir-aor.description: Area of responsibility of the CJTF-OIR air component in this order, from eastern Jordan to the Euphrates valley; the airspace control area follows it.
oir-aor.name: OIR area of responsibility

oir-cl.description: Coordination level separating land-component aviation below from fixed-wing traffic above.
oir-cl.name: OIR coordination level

oir-flot.description: Forward line of own troops of the partner land force at the start of the period.
oir-flot.name: OIR FLOT

coordination_instructions: Fires short of the line that may affect the land force are coordinated with its fire support element.
oir-fscl.description: Fire support coordination line set by the partner land force north of the FLOT; the Cobalt and Onyx kill boxes lie beyond it.
oir-fscl.name: OIR FSCL

onyx-box.description: Purple kill box east of Cobalt for combined air and surface fires against the Cobalt compound and its supply routes.
onyx-box.name: Onyx kill box
restrictions: Aircraft remain at or above the 8000 ft MSL floor while the box is open.

coordination_instructions: No fires or their effects across the line without coordination with the affected task force.
pewter-rfl.description: Restrictive fire line between Task Force Bastion attacking north and Task Force Pewter converging from the east; set by the partner land force, the common commander.
pewter-rfl.name: Bastion and Pewter RFL

coordination_instructions: Task Force Bastion crosses PL BRASS at 1330Z after the Cobalt kill box opens.
pl-brass.description: Phase line BRASS, designated as the line of departure of Task Force Bastion; it follows the FLOT at the start of the period.
pl-brass.name: PL BRASS

coordination_instructions: Report PL NICKEL to Warhawk; CAS friendlies lines use the last reported phase line.
pl-nickel.description: Phase line NICKEL along the desert road to Deir ez-Zor; Task Force Bastion reports crossing it to Warhawk and Axeman.
pl-nickel.name: PL NICKEL

coordination_instructions: No Task Force Bastion element advances beyond PL ZINC; security forces may push to it.
pl-zinc.description: Phase line ZINC, the limit of advance of Task Force Bastion, short of the FSCL and the Cobalt and Onyx kill boxes.
pl-zinc.name: PL ZINC

quarry-nfa.description: No-fire area that protects a civilian water pumping station between the FLOT and the FSCL.
quarry-nfa.name: Quarry Springs NFA
restrictions: No fires or effects into the area unless the establishing headquarters approves each mission.

coordination_instructions: Helicopters inbound to Sage enter on the Sage FARP approach after the air defence controller confirms weapons hold.
sage-shoradez.description: Short-range air defence engagement zone over the Sage FARP, where an Avenger platoon has engagement responsibility.
sage-shoradez.name: Sage SHORADEZ

sentinel-aewa.description: Airborne early warning area over eastern Jordan around the Sentinel surveillance orbit.
sentinel-aewa.name: Sentinel early warning area
sentinel-aewa.purpose: Reserve airspace for the airborne early warning aircraft.

shell-aara.description: Air-to-air refuelling area over the Syria-Iraq-Jordan border triangle, around the Shell tanker track.
shell-aara.name: Shell refuelling area
shell-aara.purpose: Reserve a block for tanker and receiver join-ups.
restrictions: Non-refuelling traffic remains clear unless coordinated with Darkstar.

sierra-mta.description: Military training area north of the Desert MOA for air combat training.
sierra-mta.name: Sierra Training Area
restrictions: Coordinate entry with the scheduling agency.

silver-gate.description: Entry and exit gate where recovering and departing aircraft begin their transit in the Silver transit corridor.
silver-gate.name: Silver gate

silver-tc.description: Rear-area transit corridor from the Jordanian bases to the Juniper ingress gate, routing aircraft through friendly air defences.
silver-tc.name: Silver transit corridor
silver-tc.purpose: Route inbound and outbound traffic past the Granite missile engagement zone with minimum risk.
restrictions: Air traffic services are not provided inside the corridor.

tiger-orbit.description: Racetrack north-west of the objective area, used first for combat air patrol and then for airborne early warning.
tiger-orbit.name: Tiger

trp-01.description: Target reference point at the road junction south-east of the Cobalt vehicle park; Axeman gives Cobalt targets as offsets from it.
trp-01.name: TRP 01
trp-01.position_description: Road junction south-east of the revetted vehicle park in the Cobalt compound.
